cache.caveat: Prefix-cache counters are upstream-global and vLLM-specific (null when the upstream exposes no /metrics); kv_cache_usage_peak is a best-effort ~50ms sample of the KV-cache capacity fraction, not comparable across models.

notes: Fixture is synthetic Project Atlas state (generated in `sidecar/demo.py`; no real project data).
Broadcast is deliberately the strongest naive baseline: one identical, stable-order fabric blob in every system message, maximizing prefix-cache reuse.
Accuracy is a deterministic substring check (no LLM judge) proving information parity, not answer quality; both arms use the exact same scorer.
Broadcast ran first; the arms use different system prefixes so upstream prefix-cache state cannot leak between them.

Prefix-cache counters are warm-cache numbers: the upstream cache persists across requests and runs, so prompts already sent earlier in the same session (including a smoke run with identical messages) show up as hits; cache deltas are not a cold-start measurement.
Small n: 6 objectives x 1 repeat; temperature=0.0 requested, max_tokens=8, non-streaming.
Broadcast renders all stored blocks (6687 tokens) including the quarantined draft (the baseline applies no policy); compiled packets deny the draft (lifecycle:draft) and include only relevant blocks.
